name: Side Plank
summary: A side-lying hold that trains the obliques and the muscles on the side of the trunk and hip, improving lateral stability.
setup: Lie on your side with the elbow directly under the shoulder and the legs stacked.
Place the top hand on the hip or extend it up.
Brace your abs before you lift.
execution: Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep the hips stacked and the neck neutral.
Lower under control and repeat on the other side.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag: squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.
Rolling forward or back: keep the shoulders and hips stacked.
Elbow in front of or behind the shoulder: place it directly under.
Holding too long with poor form: shorten the hold or bend the knees.
